_comment: 东超厨房菜谱（kitchen.js 加载）。ingredients 消耗仓库作物；sell_price ≈ 原料散卖价 ×2~2.5（加工溢价，给长线作物需求端出口）；xp ≈ 原料 XP 合计 ×1.5。改这里即可调菜谱，无需动代码。unlock_level 控制解锁。

recipes.tip_zh: 猛火快炒，出锅前一点蒜末，就是店里最常卖的家常味。
recipes.tip_en: High heat, quick toss, garlic at the end — the everyday classic.

recipes.tip_zh: 刀背一拍更入味，蒜末香醋一拌，夏天的开胃第一名。
recipes.tip_en: Smack it with the flat of the knife — garlic and black vinegar do the rest.

recipes.tip_zh: 国民下饭菜。鸡蛋用自家鸡舍的，先炒蛋后下番茄。
recipes.tip_en: The national comfort dish — eggs first, tomatoes after (coop eggs included).

recipes.tip_zh: 韭菜 + 鸡蛋 + 粉丝，烙到两面金黄。割三茬正好包一锅。
recipes.tip_en: Chives, egg and glass noodles, pan-fried golden — three cuttings make one batch.

recipes.tip_zh: 皮蛋咸蛋吊出的上汤，娃娃菜煮到透亮，清爽不寡淡。
recipes.tip_en: Century-egg broth, cabbage simmered translucent — light but never bland.

recipes.tip_zh: 夏天的下火汤。冬瓜炖到半透明，汤色清甜。
recipes.tip_en: Summer's cooling soup — simmer until the melon turns translucent.

recipes.tip_zh: 嫩姜切细丝铺满鱼身，蒸八分钟淋热油——姜是这道菜的灵魂。
recipes.tip_en: Julienned young ginger, eight minutes of steam, hot oil to finish.

recipes.tip_zh: 甜玉米粒 + 松子 + 青豆，加一小勺糖，孩子的最爱。
recipes.tip_en: Sweet kernels, pine nuts, peas, a spoonful of sugar — every kid's favourite.

recipes.tip_zh: 春笋切滚刀块，热油加糖红烧到收汁，脆嫩回甜，一年就等这一口。
recipes.tip_en: Roll-cut bamboo braised in hot oil and sugar until glazed — crunchy, sweet, worth the year-long wait.

recipes.tip_zh: 荔枝去核冰镇，加气泡水和薄荷，夏天最解暑的一杯。
recipes.tip_en: Pitted chilled lychees dropped into sparkling water with mint — summer's most refreshing glass.

recipes.tip_zh: 龙眼肉 + 红枣 + 枸杞煮水，温补养气，妈妈们的下午茶首选。
recipes.tip_en: Longan flesh, red dates and goji simmered into a warming tonic — moms' favourite afternoon tea.

recipes.tip_zh: 佛手瓜去皮切细丝，盐腌挤水，蒜末香醋香油一拌，爽脆开胃。
recipes.tip_en: Peel and julienne chayote, salt and squeeze, toss with garlic, vinegar and sesame oil — crisp and bright.

recipes.tip_zh: 韭黄切寸段，蛋液半熟时下锅，10 秒出锅——鲜嫩清香不能老。
recipes.tip_en: Cut yellow chives into pieces, fold into half-set eggs, 10 seconds out — tender and fragrant, never overcooked.

recipes.tip_zh: 薄饼皮裹榴莲肉 + 淡奶油，冷藏后一口爆浆，甜品店招牌同款。
recipes.tip_en: Thin crepe wrapping durian flesh and light cream, chilled — the dessert-shop signature.
